title: Never Have I Ever
description: Read the card out loud. If you've done it, put a finger down.

cards.text: Never have I ever fallen asleep in a movie theater.
Never have I ever forgotten someone's name right after meeting them.
Never have I ever sent a text to the wrong person.
Never have I ever pretended to be busy to avoid someone.
Never have I ever laughed at the wrong moment.
Never have I ever gotten lost in my own city.
Never have I ever binge-watched an entire series in one day.
Never have I ever sung karaoke in front of strangers.
Never have I ever tripped in public and played it cool.
Never have I ever eaten dessert before dinner.
Never have I ever stayed up all night for no good reason.
Never have I ever talked to a pet like it understood me.
Never have I ever re-gifted a present.
Never have I ever pretended to like a gift I didn't.
Never have I ever gotten a nickname I couldn't shake.
Never have I ever lied about my age.
Never have I ever waved back at someone who wasn't waving at me.
Never have I ever forgotten why I walked into a room.
Never have I ever won a trophy or a medal.
Never have I ever tried to speak a language I don't know.
Never have I ever cried at a commercial.
Never have I ever eaten food that fell on the floor.
Never have I ever pretended to understand something I didn't.
Never have I ever gone a whole day in pajamas.
Never have I ever taken a nap that ruined my sleep schedule.
Never have I ever gotten a song stuck in my head all day.
Never have I ever laughed so hard I couldn't breathe.
Never have I ever forgotten an important birthday.
Never have I ever tried and failed to whistle a tune.
Never have I ever danced when I thought no one was watching.
Never have I ever gotten lost following GPS directions.
Never have I ever stayed in bed just to avoid the day.
